verdict.rationale: Mesh exposes the core workflows through its API: customer creation and screening (sync, async and batch), result retrieval, and webhook management. The docs also state that cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either in the web app or via the API, and an OpenAPI schema and Postman collection are offered. However, no document claims full UI parity, and API credentials are generated and permissioned in the web application rather than through any documented API. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API-based credential and access management, API-documented configuration of risk-score equations and screening configurations, and independent corroboration.
